courses.title: End of Life Care and Bardo Support
courses.description: One-to-one online sessions in which Lama Justin von Bujdoss offers pastoral care to people meeting death, whether their own or a loved one's, with Vajrayana teaching on the bardo as the frame. They are also open to practitioners who want to prepare for death as part of their path.

left_out: Spiritual Care Clinic as a whole (yangtiyoga.com/spiritual-care-clinic): a team service that includes IFS counselling, a licensed clinical social worker, Sowa Rigpa diet guidance and energy-healing sessions that open with 'your chief medical concern', mostly led by other practitioners; only Lama Justin's own End of Life Care and Bardo Support service is restored.
Vajrayana Supervision/Mentorship ($100): by request, for chaplains and caregivers; not added.
flags: Restored from the Spiritual Care Clinic note: his own pastoral session (one of the clinic's services) on its own service page; it mentions a terminal diagnosis but makes no health claim.
